beta.notes:
- **Panopto recordings, found by themselves (experimental).** Settings → Panopto recordings
  connects LecCheck to your university's Panopto with an API client you create there once.
  It finds each course's folder by the course number and fills in each finished class's
  recording link, so missed classes show under Catch up on recordings by themselves. When
  several groups are recorded at the same time, the course page asks once which group is
  yours, with a suggestion. Found links are marked "Found in Panopto", and your own links always
  win. One connected device is enough: the links reach
  your other devices through sync. Android also looks once a day in the background.
  A meeting learns its group by itself when the links you pasted into it all point to one
  group. Removing a link asks whether Panopto may fill it (or, for a link Panopto found,
  whether it was wrong). In Developer mode, **Matching details** shows why each session
  got a link or not, and why each recording wasn't used. The tour offers to set it up.
- **Removing a recording link** now keeps it removed (stored as an empty link) unless you let
  Panopto fill it, so a link found in Panopto doesn't take its place.
